yoke.column.name: Yoke (roll / pitch)
yoke.column.note: chrome yoke shaft at the base collar (roll / pitch)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), yoke base seen from the front-right, yoke shaft pointing towards the camera to the right, no handle mounted
